name: Raniya
source:
Department of Automotive Engineering; Deer

A student who used an illegally modified car made by the people of her department to break through the lab's defenses.

An undergrad student who loves cars so much she ran into one. She enjoys the saying that you must be 'stronger than your automobile.'
